## Modules

- [Sqids](https://sqids.hexdocs.pm/Sqids.md): Sqids API
- [Sqids.Agent](https://sqids.hexdocs.pm/Sqids.Agent.md): Storage for `Sqids` shared state.
Like stdlib's [Agent](https://hexdocs.pm/elixir/1.15/Agent.html) but using
OTP's [`persistent_term`](https://www.erlang.org/doc/man/persistent_term).

- [Sqids.Hacks](https://sqids.hexdocs.pm/Sqids.Hacks.md): Workarounds
